title: Design bounce-reduction and cancellable affordances for micro-icon-action buttons
creator: Ava Patel
description: Reduce perceived jitter and make quick icon-only actions cancelable without breaking a11y or layout stability. This ticket scopes a lightweight pattern for compact icon/action buttons that: 1) prevents bounce/shift when transient loading or optimistic states appear, 2) surfaces a clear cancel affordance for mis-taps or long-running micro-actions, and 3) respects motion reduction and high-contrast themes. This is not a full rewrite of the Button system; it is a targeted change for stacked/compact icon actions used heavily in the Console's table rows and message action bars.
acceptance_criteria: Compact icon buttons in tables and action bars show a non-layout-shifting skeleton when entering transient loading (max layout delta < 1px),
A user can cancel a started micro-action within 2s via a visible cancel affordance (undo / cancel overlay) without triggering double actions or losing keyboard focus,
Motion-Reduce setting disables bounce and reduces animation durations to system-recommended values (no animation > 50ms),
High-contrast theme preserves contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for icon and cancel affordance hotspots,
Rollout experiment (A/B) is in place to toggle new pattern per-route; metrics tracked: accidental cancel rate, successful cancels, layout shift (CLS), and per-button click latency.
QA checklist included in ticket and automated visual regression tests added to Percy/Chromatic for light/dark/HC/motion-reduce configurations.
decision_log: Opted for an overlay-style cancel affordance instead of inline label to avoid width changes in compact containers (decision 2026-02-25),
Use 50ms max reveal for skeleton crossfade to minimize perceived latency while satisfying motion-reduce (decision 2026-03-01),
Prefer opacity/transform-only animations (no layout-affecting size changes) to keep CLS low (decision 2026-03-03)
updates: 2026-02-18 - Ticket created after design review with Console PM; identified top-2 pages with highest accidental action rate in analytics (table rows + chat action bar).

2026-02-22 - Exploratory prototypes: overlay cancel, soft-skeleton, and icon-latch variations created in Figma; initial developer feedback: overlay easiest to implement with current Button API. (link in design_links)
2026-02-25 - Accessibility pass: WCAG contrast target reviewed; cancel affordance must meet 4.5:1 on both HC and normal themes. Adjusted cancel color tokens.
2026-03-01 - Motion-reduce behavior defined: all micro bounce > 30ms reduced to instant or 25ms linear fade. Engineers asked for explicit timing constants in spec. Added timing table.

2026-03-05 - Merged engineering spike PR implementing skeleton crossfade and overlay cancel for isolated components (see related_prs). Found edge-case where rapid double-clicks triggered both optimistic action and cancel — added debounce + idempotency notes.
2026-03-09 - Visual QA: Percy snapshots added for desktop and mobile widths; one regression found in legacy ghost variant where overlay z-index clipped; follow-up task assigned to ENG-12598.
2026-03-14 - Updated patterns with keyboard flow: cancel overlay reachable by Escape, and by a long-press context action for touch accessibility. Updated acceptance criteria accordingly.
notes: Keep the change gated behind feature-flag with telemetry. Instrument accidental action and cancel rates for 2 weeks before a wider rollout. Coordinate with Growth for any UX experiment gating. Do not change core token names; add token aliases for cancel affordance to avoid breaking buyers of the design-system package.
qa_checklist: Verify no layout shift across light/dark/high-contrast themes (measured CLS < 0.01),
Validate cancel via keyboard (Escape) and screen reader announcement for cancel affordance,
Confirm motion-reduce toggles disable bounce and reduce durations,
Run visual diffs in Percy for table-row, action-bar, and compact toolbar contexts
follow_up_tasks: Split token alias PR to avoid breaking consumers (DES-824567-T1),
Add e2e idempotency test for cancel + optimistic action (DES-824567-T2)
Docs: update Button migration notes and pattern guidance (DES-824567-T3)
